name: fb_tap
summary: Self-feedback tap (audio rate): the level-gained input averaged over this sample and the previous one, so the feedback follows the operator's own level and the two-tap average damps the Nyquist mode. `level` (0..32767) is pushed by the Q15 key-follow `k` and velocity-follow `vk` factors into the block-derived `level_eff`. When `level_eff` is 0 the whole body is skipped, so feedback at 0 costs nothing.
